```{r}
baseline_mean_cols <- grep(
  "^baseline.*mean",
  colnames(merged_df),
  value = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

cancer_cols  <- grep("_mean_NonImmuneEpithelium$", colnames(merged_df), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
```

```{r}

###run limma on cell types by prognostic group
# Create a new df with prognostic groups merged in — original merged_df untouched
# ── Create analysis_df ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
analysis_df <- merge(merged_df, prognostic_groups, by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)

# ── Filter to non-NA risk_grp BEFORE building anything ───────────────────────
analysis_df <- analysis_df %>% filter(!is.na(risk_grp))
cat("nrow(analysis_df) after filter:", nrow(analysis_df), "\n")

all_cell_cols <- c(cancer_cols, stroma_cols, cytT_cols, helperT_cols, regT_cols)

# ── Build expression matrix ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
expr_mat <- t(as.matrix(analysis_df[, all_cell_cols]))
colnames(expr_mat) <- analysis_df$patient_id

# ── Design matrix ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
risk_grp <- factor(analysis_df$risk_grp, levels = c("Low", "High"))  # local var
design   <- model.matrix(~ 0 + risk_grp)                              # same name
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # → risk_grpLow, risk_grpHigh

stopifnot(ncol(expr_mat) == nrow(design))

# ── Contrast ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
contrast_mat <- makeContrasts(
  HighvsLow = risk_grpHigh - risk_grpLow,
  levels = design
)

# ── Fit ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fit  <- lmFit(expr_mat, design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_mat)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

# ── Extract results ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
results_limma <- topTable(fit2,
                          coef          = "HighvsLow",
                          number        = Inf,
                          adjust.method = "BH",
                          sort.by       = "P")
# ── Annotate by cell type ────────────────────────────────────────
results_limma$cell_type <- dplyr::case_when(
  rownames(results_limma) %in% cancer_cols  ~ "NonImmuneEpithelium",
  rownames(results_limma) %in% stroma_cols  ~ "NonImmuneStroma",
  rownames(results_limma) %in% cytT_cols    ~ "CytotoxicT",
  rownames(results_limma) %in% helperT_cols ~ "HelperT",
  rownames(results_limma) %in% regT_cols    ~ "RegulatoryT",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
write.csv(results_limma, "limma_differential_abundance_PoorvsGood_fn.csv")
saveRDS(results_limma,   "limma_differential_abundance_PoorvsGood_fn.rds")

# ── Quick look ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
head(results_limma, 20)

cat("ncol(expr_mat):", ncol(expr_mat), "\n")
cat("nrow(design):  ", nrow(design),   "\n")
cat("nrow(analysis_df):", nrow(analysis_df), "\n")
```
```{r}
# ── Define cell_types from annotated results ──────────────────────────────────
results_limma$feature <- rownames(results_limma)  # ensure feature col exists

cell_types <- unique(results_limma$cell_type)
cat("Cell types found:", cell_types, "\n")



options(scipen = 999)

# ── UP IN HIGH ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for (ct in cell_types) {
  tbl <- results_limma %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct, logFC > 0.1) %>%
    arrange(desc(logFC)) %>%
    select(feature, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) next

  cat("\n% ====== UP IN HIGH |", ct, "======\n")
  cat(kable(tbl,
            format   = "latex",
            booktabs = TRUE,
            caption  = paste("Up in High Risk –", ct),
            col.names = c("Feature", "logFC", "AveExpr", "t", "P-value", "Adj. P-value")),
      "\n")
}

# ── REDUCED IN HIGH RISK ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for (ct in cell_types) {
  tbl <- results_limma %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct, logFC < -0.1) %>%
    arrange(logFC) %>%
    select(feature, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) next

  cat("\n% ====== REDUCED IN HIGH RISK |", ct, "======\n")
  cat(kable(tbl,
            format    = "latex",
            booktabs  = TRUE,
            caption   = paste("Features with reduced expression in High Risk group --", ct,
                              "(logFC $< -0.1$)"),
            col.names = c("Feature", "logFC", "AveExpr", "t", "P-value", "Adj. P-value")),
      "\n")

}
```

```{r}
# ── Check group counts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
table(analysis_df$risk_grp)

# ── Check factor levels (Low should be reference = first) ─────────────────────
levels(risk_grp)

# ── Check design matrix maps correctly ────────────────────────────────────────
head(data.frame(
  patient    = analysis_df$patient_id,
  risk_grp   = analysis_df$risk_grp,
  design_Low  = design[, "risk_grpLow"],
  design_High = design[, "risk_grpHigh"]
), 10)

# ── Check contrast direction ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# HighvsLow = High - Low
# So logFC > 0 means HIGHER in High
# So logFC < 0 means LOWER in High = higher in Low
cat("Contrast is: High - Low\n")
cat("logFC > 0 = enriched in HIGH\n")
cat("logFC < 0 = enriched in LOW\n")

# ── Sanity check with a known marker ─────────────────────────────────────────
# e.g. FOXP3 should be higher in regulatory T cells
results_limma %>%
  filter(grepl("FOXP3", feature)) %>%
  select(feature, cell_type, logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val)
```

```{r}
results_limma <- results_limma %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cell_type = dplyr::recode(
      cell_type,
      "NonImmuneEpithelium" = "Cancer Cells"
    )
  )


colours <- c(
  "Low"  = "#004B23",   # enriched in Low / reduced in High
  "High" = "#800000",   # enriched in High
  "ns"   = "grey70"     # not significant
)

# ── Prepare data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
volcano_df <- results_limma %>%
  mutate(
    marker      = gsub("baseline_Mean\\.Cell\\.(.+)_mean_.+", "\\1", feature),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(P.Value),
    direction   = dplyr::case_when(
      P.Value < 0.05 & logFC >  0.1 ~ "High",
      P.Value < 0.05 & logFC < -0.1 ~ "Low",
      TRUE                          ~ "ns"
    ),
    label = ifelse(direction != "ns", marker, NA)
  ) %>%
  mutate(direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Low", "High", "ns")))

colours <- c(
  "Low"  = "#004B23",
  "High" = "#800000",
  "ns"   = "grey70"
)
for (ct in cell_types) {

  p <- ggplot(
    volcano_df %>% filter(cell_type == ct),
    aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p,
        colour = direction, label = label)
  ) +
    geom_point(aes(size = ifelse(direction == "ns", 0.8, 1.2)),
               alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text_repel(
      na.rm         = TRUE,
      size          = 2.8,
      max.overlaps  = 20,
      segment.size  = 0.3,
      segment.color = "grey50",
      fontface      = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.1, 0.1),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = colours,
      labels = c(
        "High" = "Enriched in High Risk",
        "Low"  = "Reduced in High Risk",
        "ns"   = "Not significant"
      )
    ) +
    scale_size_identity() +
    labs(
      title   = paste("Differential Protein Abundance: High vs Low Risk Groups –", ct),
      x       = "log Fold Change (High – Low)",
      y       = expression(-log[10](P~value)),
      colour  = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA)
    )

  print(p)
}
table(volcano_df$direction, useNA = "ifany")
unique(volcano_df$direction)

nrow(volcano_df)

# 2. How many rows for each cell type?

volcano_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_all   = dplyr::n(),
    n_fdr   = sum(!is.na(direction)),
    n_high  = sum(direction == "High"),
    n_low   = sum(direction == "Low"),
    n_ns    = sum(direction == "ns")
  )
print(ct)

volcano_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    min_logFC = min(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_logFC = max(logFC, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
p_test <- ggplot(
  volcano_df %>% dplyr::filter(cell_type == ct),
  aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p)
) +
  geom_point(colour = "black", size = 2)

print(p_test)
```

```{r}
ct <- "Cancer Cells"   # or whatever exact value is in volcano_df$cell_type

p <- ggplot(
  volcano_df %>% dplyr::filter(cell_type == ct),
  aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p, colour = direction)
) +
  # points
  geom_point(aes(size = ifelse(direction == "ns", 0.8, 1.2)),
             alpha = 0.8) +
  # labels only for non‑ns (because label is NA otherwise)
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    na.rm         = TRUE,
    size          = 2.8,
    max.overlaps  = 20,
    segment.size  = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    fontface      = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.1, 0.1),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Low"  = "#004B23",
      "High" = "#800000",
      "ns"   = "grey70"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "High" = "Enriched in High Risk",
      "Low"  = "Reduced in High Risk",
      "ns"   = "Not significant"
    )
  ) +
  scale_size_identity() +
  labs(
    title  = paste("Differential Protein Abundance: High vs Low Risk Groups –", ct),
    x      = "log Fold Change (High – Low)",
    y      = expression(-log[10](P~value)),
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom"
)
print(p)
```
